comparator.name: Public Administration (Bestuurskunde)
comparator.sourceNotes: The official 2026–27 curriculum accounts for exactly 180 ECTS: 60 compulsory ECTS in year 1, 60 compulsory ECTS in year 2, and year 3 with 42 compulsory ECTS plus an 18-ECTS mobility window or minor. Zero-credit orientation, Dutch-language testing and GROW development are excluded from the total. The 12-ECTS year-long public-administration placement, 12-ECTS thesis and genuine 18-ECTS minor or exchange space remain explicit; no elective content is invented.

notes.text: Tilburg combines public administration, law, politics, sociology, economics and organisations in a fixed two-year sequence, then requires a 12-ECTS public-sector placement and 12-ECTS thesis. UCR can build coherent governance, public-organisation and public-law pathways, but it does not reproduce the compulsory professional placement or the same integrated disciplinary spine; the 18-ECTS mobility window is preserved as genuine open space.
The Tilburg programme is Dutch-taught, whereas UCR is English-taught. This comparison assesses academic content and structure rather than language of instruction.
